title: Will this plugin work?
description:
Match what a plugin needs against what the host offers.

```
host API 2.3, capabilities: render, audio, save
plugin "fire" needs API 2.1, render      -> ok
plugin "net"  needs API 2.0, network     -> refused: missing capability network
plugin "next" needs API 3.0              -> refused: needs a newer host (3.0 > 2.3)
plugin "old"  needs API 1.4              -> refused: built for an old major version
```
hints: Check the major first, then the minor, then the capabilities (lesson 5.02).
Loop over the plugin's capabilities and test each with `offered.count(name)`: the first one that is not offered gives the "missing capability" message.
requirements: Versions are `major.minor`; a plugin works when the majors are equal and the host's minor is at least the plugin's.
Every needed capability must be offered.
stretch: Let plugins say which capabilities are optional and run without them.
